verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Revenue increased 40% to DKK 126.5m (2024: DKK 90.1m), EBITDA grew 26% to DKK 31.1m (2024: DKK 24.7m), and Profit Before Tax (EBT) surged 109% to DKK 19.0m (2024: DKK 9.1m), driven by scaling of core titles and ad revenue optimization.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Highlights & Key Ratios table (page 24); Financial Performance section (pages 24-27)

candidate_sentences.text: Revenue and other operating income increased 40% to DKK 126.5 million from DKK 90.1 million in 2024.
EBITDA rose 26% to DKK 31.1 million, while profit before tax more than doubled by 109% to DKK 19.0 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager—collectively generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, driven by Truck Manager's foundational scaling (revenue growth from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025) and Farm Manager's successful July 2025 launch with 5 million pre-registrations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section (pages 13-20); Game Breakdown table (page 13); Truck Manager section (page 17); Farm Manager section (page 18)

candidate_sentences.text: The “Big 3” titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager and Farm Manager—accounted for 67% of group revenue, or DKK 85 million, compared with 35% in 2024, and generated DKK 20 million of EBITDA versus DKK 9 million.

Truck Manager, launched in late 2024, generated DKK 25.2 million compared with DKK 1.2 million previously, while Farm Manager contributed DKK 22.0 million during its first six months following its July launch.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic ad revenue optimization initiated in late September 2025 boosted In-App Ads (IAA) revenue by 100% to DKK 18.5m, improving monetization efficiency by eliminating platform fees and increasing IAA's share of total revenue to 14.6% (2024: 10.2%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section (pages 21-22); Financial Performance section (page 26)

candidate_sentences.text: In-app advertising revenue doubled to DKK 18.5 million and increased to 14.6% of total revenue from 10.2%, supporting direct-cost efficiency because advertising is not subject to platform fees.

verified_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%) and EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, with strategic focus on optimizing the existing portfolio, disciplined investment in Train Manager 2 and Space Manager, and maintaining margin discipline amid regulatory uncertainty.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K5 are all PRESENT with clear evidence in the candidate summary. K6 is MISSING because there is no mention of the framework-driven development strategy, reusable codebases, or retrofitting features across titles, which are core components of this criterion. The overall coverage is strong for financial performance, guidance, and liquidity, but the absence of strategic development framework details prevents a perfect score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected, with consistent progression from overall performance to specific drivers, financial metrics, and future guidance. There are no self-contradictions: margin explanations (S5-S6) clarify the relationship between reported and adjusted figures without conflict. Comparisons between periods (S2-S4, S7-S11, S17) are consistent and support the stated growth narrative. Organizational flow is clear, moving from company-wide results to product-level contributions, operational drivers, and financial position. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity. Arithmetic differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions because the candidate does not claim they are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
